IRS990.ActivityOrMissionDesc: THE ORGANIZATION'S MISSION IS TO REPRESENT AND SERVE ALL PHYSICIANS AND THEIR PATIENTS IN ORDER TO PRESERVE QUALITY CARE AND ENHANCE THE ROLE OF MEDICINE IN SOCIETY. THE ORGANIZATION PROVIDES SERVICES TO ITS MEMBERS, THE MEDICAL COMMUNITY AND THE PUBLIC IN SAN DIEGO COUNTY. THE ORGANIZATION DERIVES ITS REVENUE FROM ANNUAL MEMBERSHIP DUES, RENTAL INCOME OF OFFICE SPACE, ADMINISTRATIVE FEES, ADVERTISING AND SALES ASSOCIATED WITH THE PUBLICATION OF THE MONTHLY SAN DIEGO PHYSICIAN MAGAZINE.
